trade_critiques.root_cause: SELL @ 1.14154 entered at 16:30 UTC Jul 22 (after US session closed). SL hit at 05:46 UTC Jul 23 during Asian session low liquidity. Volume 7.93 lots = 1.03% risk (double FTMO 0.5% target). Held 13h16m with no cooldown or session filter.

recommendations: Fix timezone detection bug: change datetime.now().hour to datetime.now(timezone.utc).hour in bot main loop
Reduce position sizing: 7.93 lots → ~4 lots (0.5% risk on $94K balance)
Kill zombie bot instances: 3 idle propfirm_pass_bot.py processes at ~27MB each

structured_recommendations.change: Fix UTC/local timezone confusion in session window detection
structured_recommendations.detail: Bot uses datetime.now().hour (local UTC+8) but window is declared in UTC. On UTC+8, 13:00 UTC = 21:00 local, but the comparison is against local hour 13-15. Change to datetime.now(timezone.utc).hour.
structured_recommendations.testable: Would have blocked this trade (entered at local 00:30 = 16:30 UTC) AND all 6+ prior outside-window trades.
structured_recommendations.risk: None — this is a correction, not a strategy change. The bot will only trade during the intended 13-15 UTC window.

structured_recommendations.change: Reduce position sizing to 0.5% risk per trade
structured_recommendations.detail: Current 7.93 lots on $94K balance = ~1.03% risk ($80/pip). Target: ~4 lots = 0.5% risk. Calculate as: target_risk_pct * balance / (SL_distance_in_pips * pip_value).
structured_recommendations.testable: Would have reduced this loss from -$991 to -$500.
structured_recommendations.risk: Smaller position means smaller gains on winners. Acceptable trade-off for FTMO challenge preservation.
